hypotheses.quote: a cylinder inscribed in a sphere of radius R (radius, half-height and R form a right triangle)

quotes.goal: Show that the height of a cylinder of maximum volume that can be inscribed in a sphere of radius R is 2R/√3. Find the volume of the largest cylinder.

note: Cylinder radius r and height h; the maximum volume 4πR³/(3√3) is stated as a claim so it is checked.
